يوضح هذا المستند فحص المعدات I1، الذي يجب إجراؤه 
كل ستة أشهر كما هو موضح بواسطة M6 في شريط العنوان.

The Dynapure Filter is 
 designed to remove particles of mist from contaminated air, and discharge 
 clean air to the atmosphere. The filter draws in contaminated air and removes 
 the mist by spinning action of the drum and filter element. 
The collected particles are discharged to 
 the drain, and the clean air is exhausted through the outlet. The filter can be 
 used in many industrial applications. It is recommended that the Dynapure should 
 continue to be operated at least twenty minutes after the machine being 
 exhausted is shut off. This will allow time for the unit to purge itself of 
 oil.

sections.text:
Remove two of the hex screws 
 that mount the motor. This will release the secondary filter retainer and 
 still hold the motor in place. Remove retainer and pull out the retainer 
 screen, Secondary filter, and E-Z kleen. Rinse secondary filter and E-Z kleen 
 in solvent and wipe retainer and retainer screen with a rag. Allow filers to 
 dry.

Using a rag soaked with solvent. 
 Clean the inside and outside of the casing and the outside of the motor. Check 
 drain to make sure opening is not restricted.

Replace E-Z kleen, secondary 
 filter retainer screen and retainer in this order. Fasten retainer to motor.

Replace drum and impeller and 
 fasten securely with shaft nut. Drum must seat against shaft shoulder to 
 provide proper running clearance in casing.

Place new throwaway liner inside 
 the primary filter. Position liner so the seam is opposite the primary filter 
 seam. Allow ends to butt together. Do not overlap. Smooth out wrinkles.

Replace inlet cover and secure 
 latch.

The installation should be 
 checked periodically for air leaks in the hose. Hose connections. Drainage 
 connections, etc. it is suggested a planned maintenance program be established 
 to insure optimum performance.
